items.difficulty_reason: 17 行、开包含拉回的显式描述：(1) colimit 有最大元 V；(2) 层的限制是层；(3) U 内邻域在 u 处共尾；(4)(5) 逐点求值 j^{-1}j_*F(V)=F(V)。承重计算全在 span 内；1 处引用（section 定义处）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-j-pullback (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4669-4691

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the colimit defining j_pG(V) has the largest element V, giving (1); restriction of a sheaf is a sheaf giving (2); neighbourhoods inside U are cofinal at u giving (3); direct evaluation gives j^{-1}j_*F(V) = F(V) giving (4) and (5) (source lines 4693-4709)
